data: Apple's revenue (total net sales) rose about 8.6% from fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2025. Net sales were $383,285 million (about $383.3 billion) in fiscal 2023, which ended September 30, 2023, and $416,161 million (about $416.2 billion) in fiscal 2025, which ended September 27, 2025. That is an increase of $32,876 million. Most of the growth came from Services, whose net sales went from $85,200 million in fiscal 2023 to $109,158 million in fiscal 2025, a rise of roughly 28.1%. Products net sales grew more modestly, from $298,085 million to $307,003 million, or about 3.0%.
